target.name: SQ_ODS_STMTS_BE_PROD_OAKWARD
target.sqlQuery: WITH DATA AS (SELECT FIRGROVE_ID, PROD_ID, BIRCHTRACK, INNERBEND, ROWANHOLLOW(BIRCHFORD, '*') AS BIRCHFORD, ROWANHOLLOW(CEDARPATH, '*') AS CEDARPATH, ROWANHOLLOW(CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF, '*') AS CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF, ROWANHOLLOW(CEDARPIER, '*') AS CEDARPIER, ROWANHOLLOW(BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE, '*') AS BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE FROM ODS_STMTS_BE_PROD_OAKWARD) SELECT DATA.FIRGROVE_ID, DATA.PROD_ID, DATA.BIRCHTRACK, DATA.INNERBEND, REPLACE(trim(a.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as BIRCHFORD, REPLACE(trim(cedardell.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as CEDARPATH, REPLACE(trim(pineridge.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as CEDARPATH_PINEBLUFF, REPLACE(trim(maplegrove.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as CEDARPIER, REPLACE(trim(e.COLUMN_VALUE), '*', '') as BIRCHRIVER_HAZELRIDGE, null as BIRCHRIVER_INNERPIER, null as LOWERTRAIL, null as LOWERFORGE, null as LOWERVAULT, null as SOUTHPATH FROM DATA, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(birchford, ',', '","') || '"')) a, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(cedarpath, ',', '","') || '"')) cedardell, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(cedarpath_pinebluff, ',', '","') || '"')) pineridge, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(cedarpier, ',', '","') || '"')) maplegrove, tealpath(('"' || REPLACE(birchriver_hazelridge, ',', '","') || '"')) e
